Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment focuses on a wide array of histone PTMs using an 'unrestrictive search' (Open Search and Mass Offset Search). While super-SILAC was used as an internal standard, the authors state that quantification was not the primary focus of this specific work. The sample preparation involves chemical derivatization (PRO-PIC) to create an 'ArgC-like' digestion pattern. Phosphorylation was explicitly validated and identified, justifying the mod_phospho hint, although the study covers many other acylations and modifications.
